verdict.rationale: A tax agency with a system-to-system filing channel could plausibly publish official SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no first-party SDK or client library. EFILE is a certification process for third-party tax software, which is an adjacent channel, not an official SDK. The llms.txt probe also shows no agent-oriented developer docs are published.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
